shared_elements: possible schematic face-like motif with eye-like circular element
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic low-relief designs built from broad rounded ridges, looping curvilinear bands and raised bosses, and both arguably contain a circular eye-like or disc element within a larger motif, which gives a modest stylistic convergence. But A depicts an unmistakable frontal anthropomorphic figure with headdress, face, arms and a central disc on the torso arranged symmetrically about a vertical axis, while B shows an unordered, non-symmetric tangle of curling relief forms with no legible body plan or figural composition.
